name: flaretune
description: A self-hosted personal audio streaming application for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.verify:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml --dry-run
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --config server/wrangler.local.toml --persist-to worker/.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrations:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config server/wrangler.local.toml --persist-to worker/.wrangler/state

DB.description: FlareTune stores accounts, settings, playlists, listening data, and application state in this D1 database.

MEDIA_BUCKET.description: FlareTune stores audio, artwork, and generated lyric artifacts in this private R2 bucket.

SETUP_SECRET.description: Generate a high-entropy secret. It claims a new instance and encrypts saved AI keys, the optional Google Client Secret, and opt-in Subsonic password copies. Rotating it requires re-entering AI/Google secrets and re-enabling Subsonic; it cannot reset an administrator.
